The structure of Ba8Mo4C8O24 (reduced formula Ba2Mo(OC)2) adopts the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 44 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows carbon centers in tetrahedral coordination by four oxygen neighbors, while molybdenum is six-coordinate to oxygen, and barium centers have 12 oxygen neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement. Corner-sharing between carbon tetrahedra and face-sharing between Ba and C polyhedra are observed. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 44 sites.
